resources.string: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart

You need your own copy of the game. Copy its installation folder from your computer to this device, then select it. The files are copied into app storage. After import, the app no longer needs the original folder. The optional Mods folder is imported too.

Drag with two fingers to move the camera in space. Open Controls in the corner for the keyboard and extra buttons. Android Back works as Esc.

Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage deletes your saves. Export them first. Exports also include logs.

Exit the game before importing, restoring or exporting files. Use Restore saves to load an archive made by Export saves.
